artifact_checks_before_scoring: checkpoint SHA matches terminal fit receipt and embedded provenance
prediction SHA and sidecar match fixed epoch 1 checkpoint, metric split, output shape/dtype, finite values and exact row order
the 468 held-out evaluation groups do not occur in candidate/control direct fitting membership
candidate/control initialized from same seed-matched own checkpoint and differ only in family-loss weight
recompute official metric independently from raw prediction arrays and official labels/masks

exposure_and_membership.exposure_status: exposed development data; prior local inspection and model selection exist

independent_grader: root controller; fit/export actor must not compute or approve the result
interpretation_boundary: No public score forecast, no addition of local deltas to public best, and no promotion before independent grade and complete matched pair evidence.

metric_and_uncertainty.evaluation_unit: connected chain component; the independent grader reconstructs components and reports the count

paired_cluster_bootstrap.resample: connected components with replacement, paired across candidate/control; compute score delta on each draw

metric_and_uncertainty.prediction_mask: need_prediction AND is_scored from valid_targets row order, intersected with the fold0 evaluation groups
metric_and_uncertainty.row_weight: absolute magnitude of clipped target, as implemented by global_wp_clip2_v1
metric_and_uncertainty.uncertainty_limit: Bootstrap conditions on fixed trained checkpoints and exposed groups; it excludes training variability and public-transfer uncertainty.

planned_complete_pair.report_pair_summary: mean of the two paired seed deltas; retain both deltas and do not select a seed
planned_complete_pair.training_variation: only two matched seeds; descriptive, not a precise population estimate

preliminary_seed3_delivery.allowed_output: Report candidate seed3 standalone WP and artifact validity as descriptive screening only after independent grading.
preliminary_seed3_delivery.not_a_treatment_claim: The matched seed3 effect is unavailable until the family-off prediction is graded.

primary_outcome.comparison: Within each seed, candidate score minus matched family-head-off control score on the identical official fold0 row mask; candidate and control are paired at the connected-component level.
primary_outcome.official_endpoint: global_wp_clip2_v1; score T0 and T1 separately, then use the official mean
primary_outcome.question: Does enabling raw family-head supervision at coefficient 0.1 improve the fixed student endpoint relative to the same 31-output/cache/initializer recipe with coefficient 0.0?
